recommendation: DEFER — no assumption changes alter the -1 net effect. Governance overhead has increased, not decreased, since S724. The 4-session startup estimate is a floor. The binding constraint has not shifted. Breakeven at 36 sessions remains unreachable within the 20-session program horizon.
